results.title: Sam Johnstone Siblings: Meet Ryan and Max Johnstone
results.description: Samuel Luke Johnstone, born on 25 March 1993 in Preston, Lancashire, is an English professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper. He is currently on loan at Scottish Premiership side Celtic from EFL Championship club Wolverhampton Wanderers.
